title: Register a new env flag end-to-end (registry row + generated doc)
prompt: Register a new env flag MERCURY_BENCH_CANARY in this repo's flag registry. Requirements: (1) add a row to FLAG_REGISTRY in src/substrate/flagRegistry.ts with kind 'opt-in', summary 'benchmark canary (inert)', off 'byte-identical', consumer 'src/substrate/flagRegistry.ts', keeping the array alphabetized; (2) regenerate scripts/substrate/.out/FLAG-REGISTRY.md via `~/.bun/bin/bun run scripts/substrate/gen-flag-table.ts`; (3) the registry gate `~/.bun/bin/bun run scripts/substrate/prove-flag-registry.ts` must stay green. Do not change any other behavior.
